video_title: Spurs Need A GOON To Hit Hartenstein + Predicting LeBron's FINAL Move

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: OKC needs to play physically against Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: You got to scratch, claw, punch, grab, whatever you got to do to Wembanyama all game long.
quotes.quote: Here's, okay, Game 2, talking about OKC Spurs. One, we talked about it on the podcast. You got to scratch, claw, punch, grab, whatever you got to do to Wembanyama all game long. And I know I think he had what, 20 and 30 and 20 or something again, but they won. And Hartenstein is like, I don't care, like his floaters were just death darts. If you can make those floaters over him, you give yourself a chance. Two, if you're grabbing, holding, it's just going to wear on him. And you see Wembanyama is being emotionally like this, and I appreciate it, but some of his teammates got to hit Hartenstein for grabbing on his teammate. Somebody got to step up and be a goon and say this is not acceptable.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Media exaggerates LeBron James' off-season drama
quotes.excerpt: I think honestly, the media makes it more than what it really is. I think the story of the summer is where's Giannis going?
quotes.quote: I think honestly, the media makes it more than what it really is. I think the story of the summer is where's Giannis going? You know, I think LeBron, if I'm the Lakers, LeBron helped me not lose in the first round. I can't see the gravity that he creates when he's out there on the court, making other guys better, having him, you got to think the business-wise, how much are the Lakers making per game, per TV game. To me, you got to you got to make sure that you stay in communication with LeBron, that you're building a good team around Luka, but it's not necessarily just about LeBron. This is more about Luka and LeBron is that piece that I think will help him be better over the years, but yeah, it's a lot of media stuff. You all don't care if Jokic becomes a free agent, you all don't care if Paolo gets traded, but LeBron moves needles when it comes to the media.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: James Harden's defensive struggles hinder his postseason narrative
quotes.excerpt: The problem is, he is atrocious on defense. And kind of always has been for real.
quotes.quote: Sorry brother, I mean this is bad news. I don't think you can. Unless he all of a sudden turns into Michael Jordan, Magic Johnson, the problem is, he is atrocious on defense. And kind of always has been for real. He is a great player. He is what he is at this point, 37 years old. He I mean, he would have to go to NBA Finals and win. So, like, good luck. But until then, you're starting to see, especially in Game 1, they're just going at him. And when a coach openly says, hey, we're hunting James Harden, that's not a good sign. Usually you try to keep your game plan secret and he flat out said, James Alpheus Harden, that's where we're going at. If the narrative changes if they do win, listen brother, when we get there, I have to see it to believe it, because as of right now, I don't believe it.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA playoff format change to overall record is impractical due to travel
quotes.excerpt: Travel-wise, you can't do that. You can't have the Lakers playing the Knicks in a four-five game.
quotes.quote: I don't mind it. I think I don't mind the idea, but travel-wise, you can't do that. You can't have the Lakers playing the Knicks in a four-five game, going back and forth. It's just too much travel on the body. You also want to give your your home fans a chance to travel to that city. So, you know, Western Conference, let's say it's Kings Warriors, you'd have Warriors fans going to Kings game, Kings fans going to Warriors games, and then during the NBA Finals, that's when you bring both the East and West out, it justifies the travel for the teams.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Brook Lopez's successful evolution to a three-point shooter for Giannis
quotes.excerpt: Brook Lopez is a great example of somebody that was a post-up All-Star big and evolved his game to strictly shooting threes.
quotes.quote: That's a great question. So Brook Lopez is a great example of somebody that was a post-up All-Star big and evolved his game to strictly shooting threes. But, you know, like I'm a big guy, I'm not that tall I'm tall, I'm not that big. Brook Lopez is humongous and tall. Man, if I would have had his post-up game, I would have never shot threes, but he ended up shooting threes and spacing because that's what Giannis needed, he needed that space. And dude, he got a championship from it. So, hey, congrats. That was the only guy that I knew that was sort of shoot threes and that evolved to really just strictly shoot threes.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves needs to improve his playoff efficiency and defense
quotes.excerpt: He just needs to re-evaluate why he's getting why he's so inefficient in the playoffs.
quotes.quote: Well, I think Austin Reaves has struggled in the playoffs. I think his game, he just needs to re-evaluate why he's getting why he's so inefficient in the playoffs. Now, he's young, he is a very talented young player. I think he's a great player. I think during the season, he needs to address, which is hard, but what great players do. You need to address what people are doing to you or going to do to you in the playoffs. Can he get a lot better? For sure. Do I think he will? For sure. But he can't be a traffic cone in the playoffs. Like I was not the best defender, but I wasn't a traffic cone. You weren't just going at me like that. And you could check the film. I played big minutes in the playoffs. So if I was getting cooked, it was a bad matchup, but for the most part, I was not being hunted.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye lists the toughest NBA players he guarded
quotes.excerpt: Toughest guy I had to guard? Shaq, Dirk, LeBron, Dwyane Wade was an absolute gorilla.
quotes.quote: Toughest guy I had to guard? Shaq, Dirk, LeBron, Dwyane Wade was an absolute gorilla. Damn, Kobe was a monster. Pau Gasol, the year after they lost to Boston, that version of Pau Gasol was unstoppable. He was mean and tough and ornery. Yao Ming. A lot of guys. I had to guard a lot of gigantic human beings.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Rookies need alignment between themselves, front office, and family for development
quotes.excerpt: Make sure that you're on the same page with your development, with your playing time, with your vision.
quotes.quote: The talk would be about communication between yourself, your GM, your owner and the family. So if you're a new rookie, and I'm speaking a lottery picks. If you're a new rookie, what I have seen work in this NBA is when your your support and the GM that is there, are all on the same page about your development and about what the path is best for you. You look at OKC, you look at the Spurs, you look at some of these other teams like Miami that develop players really, Boston, really well. There is no disconnect between what is expected from them year in and year out to get minutes and to play and get big contracts and what is what is spoken about at home. Because if your people are like, man, you know, you're too good for this and you're this and you're that and blah blah blah, the grass is greener. The grass ain't always greener. And you look at the buy-in from OKC and the Spurs, and then you look at their young guys and how they're going to be rewarded later on in their careers with big contracts, championships, starting jobs. It's going to pay off. So that's what I would tell the rookies. Make sure that you're on the same page with your development, with your playing time, with your vision of who you want to be and what they need you to be.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye ranks Kobe Bryant sixth all-time, behind LeBron James and Michael Jordan
quotes.excerpt: I put the greatest at their position top five. So, I could have Mike or LeBron one or two.
quotes.quote: Well Chris, you're fucking stupid. Because LeBron should be either one or two. I don't care what number that is, but he's one or two. You're not going to like my answer. I put the greatest at their position top five. So, I could have Mike or LeBron one or two. That's fine. I don't care. Then I have Kareem, Tim Duncan, Magic. Then I have Kobe. So, that's where I have Kobe Bryant. I have him six.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Boston should not trade Jaylen Brown but needs to address their center position
quotes.excerpt: Is that enough to trade him, an MVP candidate? I listen, he just needs to get talked to.
quotes.quote: I wouldn't put KD on that team. And Giannis? I just think listen, what Boston has, they got something great going. No offense. They got something great going. He is a great player. Is he kind of tripping right now, doing the whole media thing? For sure. But is that enough to trade him, an MVP candidate? I listen, he just needs to get talked to. Like, hey, we got to calm down, talking to Stephen A. Smith. You're only making him more famous. You're, you know, you can hate him, hate him quietly. At the end of the day, the Boston Celtics need to address that they don't have a center in the East. It's going to be a problem, where Cat, Joel Embiid, Paolo, Durran, Mobley, Allen, those guys exist. But no, I would not trade Jaylen Brown. He's too good.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: OKC's former Big 3 couldn't win due to missed opportunities and strong opposition
quotes.excerpt: Maybe if they would have stayed together, they still would have lost. It's just a fact.
quotes.quote: Well, my guy, no way Harden was going to stay being a sixth man. He you seen they're all MVPs. Also, I think none of them can get the job done because they're old now. And then I think you look at missed opportunities. And then I think you look at how good LeBron and the Cavs were, and then you look at how good them Golden State Warriors were. So, maybe if they would have stayed together, they still would have lost. It's just a fact. I mean, shoulda coulda woulda, but you know, things happen. People think grass is greener on the other side and it ain't. It's AstroTurf.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye wants LeBron James to finish his career in Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: Go back to Cleveland. That's what I want to see. Go back home, last year, let's get it done.
quotes.quote: Go back to Cleveland. Go back to Cleveland. That's what I want to see. Go back home, last year, let's get it done. Cleveland can move on from James Harden. So now they have a ball handler. They have a guy who can play four different positions. He'll make them tougher. Or call him out and get him traded, either one. And that's just facts.
